preconditions.description: The number of steps n is between 1 and 24 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each step ai is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.
The sum of all steps a1, a2, ..., an is equal to d.
The number of bad luck numbers k is between 0 and 2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each bad luck number bi is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of good routes is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(all(prefix_sum not in b for prefix_sum in itertools.accumulate(permutation)) for permutation in itertools.permutations(a)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of permutations of a such that no prefix sum of the permutation is in the set of bad luck numbers b, modulo 10^9 + 7.
